title: Nourishing Juicy Korean Tofu Korean Fried Chicken
description: A spicy and juicy Korean dish featuring salted butter and katsuramuki-cut tofu, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this vegan-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional KFC-style Korean fried chicken, served on a lazy Susan spinner.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into katsuramuki style

instructions: Cut the extra firm tofu into katsuramuki style and set aside on a plate.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted salted butter, gochujang, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to make the marinade.
Add the cut tofu to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate large bowl, mix together the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Remove the tofu from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off, and then toss the tofu in the cornstarch mixture to coat.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully add the coated tofu to the hot oil and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the fried tofu from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Garnish the fried tofu with sesame seeds, thinly sliced scallions, and a sprinkle of Korean chili flakes if desired.
Serve the Nourishing Juicy Korean Tofu Korean Fried Chicken on a lazy Susan spinner and enjoy.
